tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Surface of genus two times a circle] 1. ch12:3.6Let $N$ be a surface of genus two. Then $N\times S^1$ admits no negatively curved metric. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch For any infinite cyclic subgroup $C\subset \pi _1(N)$, the subgroup $C\oplus \mathbb Z\subset \pi _1(N\times S^1)$ is abelian but not cyclic, contradicting item 2.

□
